propositions: review_interrupts metric is currently dimensionless and cannot distinguish between bound-exceeded (bot busy, drain working) and signal-unavailable (health probe broken, deploys running blind)
CloudWatch alarms on review_interrupts cannot tell apart opposite failure modes and require SSM shell access to journalctl to determine the reason

observability.sh must split review_interrupts into two separate metrics (review_interrupts_bound_exceeded and review_interrupts_signal_unavailable) by filtering journal patterns while retaining rolled-up total

monitoring_autodeploy.tf must replace the single review_interrupts alarm with two distinct reason-scoped alarms, each carrying only its own remediation and preserving 900s/1-datapoint latching for signal-unavailable
terraform apply must be executed in infra/terraform to activate the new alarm definitions after code merge
